basics.label: Senior Site Reliability Engineer & AI Systems Engineer
basics.summary: Enthusiastic software engineer and Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) transitioning to AI/ML operations (MLOps) and AI Software Engineering (AISE). With over 6 years of experience, my core philosophy is to build highly resilient infrastructure before implementing automated intelligence.

work.summary: Led infrastructure automation and high availability cluster management.
highlights: Architected scalable infrastructure as code using Terraform.
Ensured 99.99% core infrastructure uptime via automated observability.
Deployed CI/CD pipelines for zero-downtime updates.
